guarantees.claim: When share index s is 0, shift_rows_in[0] is continuously assigned the value of sub_bytes_out.
When share index s is greater than 0, shift_rows_in[s] is continuously assigned the value of sb_out_mask.
For every share s, an instance of aes_shift_rows is connected: .op_i to op_i, .data_i to shift_rows_in[s], and .data_o to shift_rows_out[s].
guarantees.cond: for each s in generate loop

guarantees.claim: For every share s, an instance of aes_mix_columns is connected: .op_i to op_i, .data_i to shift_rows_out[s], and .data_o to mix_columns_out[s].
guarantees.cond: for each s in generate loop

assumptions.risk: If NumShares == 0, the generate loop produces no instances, leaving shift_rows_in, shift_rows_out, and mix_columns_out unconnected and the data path incomplete.

assumptions.claim: sub_bytes_out and sb_out_mask are the correct masked data share and mask share outputs from the preceding SubBytes stage.
assumptions.cond: when the round logic is evaluated
assumptions.risk: If these signals are swapped, incorrectly computed, or corrupted, the masking scheme will be disrupted, potentially enabling side‑channel leakage of the secret data.

assumptions.claim: op_i remains stable during the combinational propagation through the shift_rows and mix_columns instances.
assumptions.cond: while the outputs are being used
assumptions.risk: If op_i changes during evaluation, it may cause glitches or incorrect operation selection, leading to a corrupted round transformation output.

uncertain_points.claim: The generate block unconditionally drives all shares with s>0 from the single signal sb_out_mask. If NumShares is intended to support more than one mask share (NumShares > 2), this would incorrectly assign identical mask values to multiple shares, breaking masking independence.
uncertain_points.cond: NumShares > 2 and the design intent is multi‑share masking
uncertain_points.risk: Identical mask shares eliminate the randomness needed for side‑channel resistance, potentially exposing secret data through power/EM analysis.

uncertain_points.claim: When NumShares is set to 1, only the s==0 path is instantiated, leaving no mask share. This results in an unmasked AES round, which may violate a security requirement that the design always operate with masking.
uncertain_points.risk: An unmasked implementation exposes the entire data path to first‑order side‑channel attacks, defeating the purpose of the masking countermeasure.
